title: Cowboys' Von Miller secures desired No. 40 from teammate with rare compensation that could last a lifetime

sources.name: CBS Sports NFL
sources.title: Cowboys' Von Miller secures desired No. 40 from teammate with rare compensation that could last a lifetime
sources.description: The veteran pass rusher gave Dallas fullback Hunter Luepke equity in his poultry business, Greener Pastures Chicken, to secure the jersey number he wore in high school and college
